en.title: Tiananmen Square and Forbidden City: Booking, Entry and Route
en.headline: How Foreign Visitors Can Plan Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City
en.description: Use a valid same-day Palace reservation for square access under current rules, bring the booked passport, enter at Meridian Gate and plan recovery.
en.heroAlt: Hall of Supreme Harmony and its courtyard in the Forbidden City with visitors in view
en.featuredLinkLabel: Plan Tiananmen and the Forbidden City

zh.title: 天安门广场与故宫参观指南：预约、入口和路线
zh.headline: 外国游客如何安排天安门广场与故宫参观
zh.description: 按现行规则持故宫当日有效预约通行广场，携带预约护照、预留安检步行时间，从午门入院并准备临时管控的备选方案。
zh.heroAlt: 故宫太和殿与院落，画面中可见游客
zh.featuredLinkLabel: 规划天安门与故宫参观
